props.title: The water cycle
props.subtitle: The same water, travelling around the planet

scenes.shows: A sun shines over a wavy sea. Small drops rise from the water into the air and fade out.

props.title: 1. Evaporation
captions: The sun warms the sea, lakes and rivers.
Some water turns into vapour and rises into the air.

scenes.shows: The rising dots slow down high in the sky and gather together, forming a cloud that grows.

props.title: 2. Condensation
captions: High up the air is cold, so the vapour turns into tiny droplets.
Millions of droplets together make a cloud.

scenes.shows: The cloud darkens and drops fall from it onto a hill and into the sea.

props.title: 3. Precipitation
captions: When droplets get too heavy, they fall as rain or snow.

scenes.shows: Rain runs down the hill as a river that flows into the sea, then the four stages appear around a ring, and a drop travels once around it.

props.title: 4. Collection
captions: Rivers carry the water back to the sea.
And then it all starts again: a cycle with no beginning or end.

props.title: Nothing is lost
takeaways: The sun powers the whole cycle
The water you drink has been around for ages
